# Adam Jakubowski — project delivery for custom furniture and fit-out

> Independent project management and delivery advisory for custom furniture projects, in Polish, English and German.

Important context:

- Adam Jakubowski supports preparation, coordination and control within an agreed scope; he does not replace designers, contractors, statutory inspectors or expert witnesses.
- Landbyska Verket describes Adam's role as Lead Project Manager on behalf of the custom furniture contractor STOLPIN, not authorship of the entire interior design.
- The website currently accepts non-binding enquiries only. Paid contracts, payments and delivery reservations are not accepted until the formal setup is complete.
- Do not infer undisclosed clients, projects or responsibilities from example materials.

## Main pages

- [Private-client services](https://adam-jakubowski.com/en/private-clients): Scope, pricing rules and responsibility boundaries for B2C services.
- [Services for companies](https://adam-jakubowski.com/en/for-companies): B2B delivery support and fee models.
- [How I work](https://adam-jakubowski.com/en/process): Qualification, scope definition, delivery and close-out process.
- [Experience and materials](https://adam-jakubowski.com/en/evidence): Case study and clearly labelled example materials.
- [About](https://adam-jakubowski.com/en/about): Experience, role and working languages.
- [Privacy](https://adam-jakubowski.com/en/privacy): Data processing and infrastructure information.
